title: Vegan Saffron Bento Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan saffron-infused bento bowl, perfect for a quick and easy lunch.
instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, mix together the sweet potatoes and coconut oil.
Spread the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, cook the wholesome rice according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, heat the saffron threads in a tablespoon of water over low heat for 5 minutes.
To assemble the bento bowl, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom of the box.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes on top of the rice.
Drizzle the saffron-infused water over the sweet potatoes.
